star: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite for Lull, a quiet handmade children's toybox. One single subject only, entire subject centered in square 1024x1024 canvas with generous transparent margins. Camera is STRICTLY straight overhead, orthographic, looking perpendicular down onto the play surface; no horizon, no front elevation, no isometric tilt. Refined simple handmade wool-felt forms: chunky readable silhouette, softened edges, broad matted fibres, restrained irregularity; tactile but NOT photorealistic macro fibre fuzz. Lighting diffuse and neutral with only very soft upper-left modelling. No cast shadow, no pedestal, no ground, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no glossy highlights, no ornate detailing, no decorative border. Transparent background with real alpha. Subject: a single little five-armed sea star seen from above, flat against the sand plane. Warm faded peach/terracotta felt, rounded asymmetrical arms, tiny subtle dotted stitching along each arm. Modestly plump center. No face, eyes or mouth. Five distinct arms only. It should feel like a hand-cut and softly stuffed little sea star, not a realistic spiny sea animal. Occupy about 72 percent of canvas width and height.
